name: D02_3_two_gains_each_get_plus_one_and_26_counts
notes: Printed: 'If you would gain life, you gain that much life plus 1 instead.' and '+2/+2 as long as you have 25 or more life.' Two separate lifelink events: 3 life becomes 4 (24), then 1 life becomes 2 (26). Each event gets its own plus 1, and 26 is 25 or more, so the Angel is a 4/4.
